original_test_intent: Run NVIDIA NVqual Test 11 against every approved GPU PCIe path, obtain readable EOM/eye-margin evidence under the correct firmware/driver stack, and determine link quality using an engineer-approved Test 11 result oracle.
original_method: Verify licensed NVqual release/checksum and GPU/driver/firmware/platform compatibility; map GPU serial/UUID/BDF/root-port/link; baseline link/AER/XID/thermals; preview exact Test 11 command/config; run bounded under OOB and telemetry; preserve complete raw report/return code/per-lane metrics; reconcile reported firmware/identity; evaluate vendor PASS plus numeric/flag policy; inspect post logs without clearing.
manual_activity: NVIDIA/platform owner supplies licensed package and EOM acceptance; operator maintains OOB/cooling/recovery.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Conceptually aligned but no executable command can be invented without the licensed release/config.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the pinned vendor invocation for NVqual Test 11 only, with exact config and hard supervisor; retain unfiltered report.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Test number 11 and PCIe EOM scope retained; readability and firmware checks remain necessary but insufficient.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Evaluate immutable vendor report per GPU/path/lane with independent PCIe/AER/XID telemetry and firmware identity.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds package trust, target identity, numeric EOM acceptance, limits and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Readable text and correct firmware do not prove the PCIe eye/margin passed.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: EOM access may be vendor/firmware specific and can perturb links; opaque Test11 PASS needs retained per-lane evidence.

project_override_considerations: Owner defines whether vendor PASS alone is accepted, required margin dimensions/units/floors, lane aggregation and treatment of unsupported paths.
